shortDefinition.en: The electronic component that samples incoming light at many photosites and produces signals for digital conversion.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 通过许多感光单元采样入射光，并产生可供数字转换信号的电子元件。

en: A sensor does not simply save a human-like view of color; reconstruction and processing are required.
zh-cn: 传感器不是直接保存人眼式色彩画面，还需要重建与处理。

example.en: The X-T5 specification lists a 23.5 × 15.7 mm sensor.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 规格列出 23.5 × 15.7 mm 传感器。

sources.title: Digital Camera Sensors — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: Photosite light sampling and conversion into digital information.
